name: connectors
title: scm:merge, written once per forge
html:
scm:merge, written once per forge

# github-scm/pull.resource.yaml
merge:
  operation: pulls/merge
  fields: [commit_title, commit_message]
  inputs:
    method:
      enum: [merge, squash, rebase]
  values:
    method:
      merge:  {merge_method: merge}
      squash: {merge_method: squash}
      rebase: {merge_method: rebase}
  bind: {sha: /head/sha}
  stale: 409
  refused: 405

the whole merge act

# gitlab/pull.resource.yaml
merge:
  operation: pulls/merge
  fields: [merge_commit_message]
  inputs:
    method:
      enum: [merge, squash]
  values:
    method:
      merge:  {squash: false}
      squash: {squash: true}
  bind: {sha: /sha}
  stale: 409
  refused: 405
# + normal: state, merged, mergeable_state

the whole merge act
say: The merge act in each connector. Same relation, same input (method), same guard (the head sha the view had), same stale and refused codes. The upstream operation, the field names and the values differ, and only here.
